read.thesis: Constellation signed ~8,500 MW of long-term contracts YTD and raised FY adjusted EPS guidance to $12.50–12.80, but supply-side evidence is limited to 1,200 MW of nuclear uprates at $4.3B, with no capacity added beyond existing fleet.

utilisation.quote: our nuclear fleet delivered a 97.2% capacity factor while completing 20 planned refueling outage days

capex.quote: Total project costs are expected to be approximately $4.3 billion, $3 billion of which is incremental growth capital from 2028 through 2032.

triggers.label: FY EPS guide raised to $12.50–12.80
triggers.quote: We are raising the midpoint and narrowing our full year adjusted operating earnings guidance range to $12.50 per share to $12.80 per share.

triggers.label: 1,200 MW uprates at $4.3B
triggers.quote: In total, these projects will deliver nearly 1,200 megawatts of additional nuclear power, most of which is scheduled for completion between 2029 and 2032.

triggers.label: 8,500 MW contracted YTD
triggers.quote: Year-to-date, we have contracted more than 8,500 megawatts well into the 2040s at compelling economics.

triggers.label: $20–50/MWh premium to PTC floor held
triggers.quote: the $20 to $50 a megawatt-hour, those still exist, right?

guidance.quote: We are raising the midpoint and narrowing our full year adjusted operating earnings guidance range to $12.50 per share to $12.80 per share.

guidance.value: to be updated at year-end call
guidance.quote: we will update our 2027 and 2028 guidance on our year-end call

guidance.value: update on or before Q4 call
guidance.quote: you should expect us to update our buyback plan on or before the fourth quarter call

prior_guidance_check.quote: We have repurchased about $3 billion of our stock in roughly the 7 months since our March business update

red_flags.label: Regulatory overhang on colocation and data-centre rules
red_flags.quote: regulatory uncertainty is always a bit of an overhang

red_flags.label: Guidance lift partly non-recurring
red_flags.quote: I wouldn't say that is transferable to all years.

evasions.quote: In terms of how much of it we'll sell and what the uptake is on that, I probably -- I did that last year, and I'm not going to do that again.
Look, I don't think we're coming in lower than we expected.
